[[File:Hoth-ST.png|thumb|250px|[[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], a planet for ice-boarding]]
'''Ice-boarding''' was a type of adventure sport practiced on snow. [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]] was one of the destinations for ice-boarding enthusiasts.<ref name="Disney">{{Disney|url=star-tours-adventures/hoth|text=Star Tours Adventures: Destinations - Hoth|nolive=1}}</ref>

The interstellar travel agency [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] was known for taking ice-boarding and [[hover-skiing]] enthusiasts to snowy planets like Hoth to enjoy the sport.<ref name="Disney" />
